_purpose: PRE-REGISTERED predictions for Phase-2 prospective validation of the distillability-geometry hypothesis. Committing this file to git (with timestamp) BEFORE running any new-teacher student distillation is the FREEZE LINE. The predictor formula below is fixed and must not be re-tuned after seeing any Phase-2 distillation outcome.

frozen_predictor.distillability_index_DI: z(teacher_acc) + z(geom_auc) + z(correct_wrong_sep), equal weights, z = standardize across the teacher set
frozen_predictor.geom_auc: 5-fold CV logistic-regression AUC predicting teacher per-sample correctness from GT-INDEPENDENT geometric features {logdet_g, boundary, entropy, margin, peak} of the teacher output distribution on Delta^4
frozen_predictor.correct_wrong_sep: |Cohen's d| of logdet_g between teacher-correct and teacher-wrong samples
frozen_predictor.note: DI is a PRIOR score: computed from teacher logprobs ONLY, never from student-distillation outcomes.

prediction_hypotheses.H1_ranking: Teacher DI rank correlates with real distillation-GAIN rank (vs zero-shot baseline). Verdict thresholds: Kendall tau >=0.6 strong; 0.3-0.6 partial; <0.3 fails.
prediction_hypotheses.H2_algorithm_scaling: Per-teacher (geom_top50 minus random_top50) student-accuracy gain INCREASES with that teacher's geom_auc. I.e. geometry-based KL-sample filtering helps more for teachers whose errors are more geometrically separable.
prediction_hypotheses.H3_weak_teacher: Low-DI teachers should be predictable as poor distillation sources WITHOUT training a student.

raw_features_note: The TRULY frozen quantities are each teacher's prior features (teacher_acc, geom_auc, correct_wrong_sep) — computed from teacher logprobs ONLY, never from student-distillation outcomes. distillability_index (DI) is a z-standardized composite over a teacher SET, so its absolute value shifts with set composition; predicted_rank is what the prospective H1 test uses. Ranks below are on the N=7 set using the Llama70B Phase-1 anchor (see llama70b_caveat).
llama70b_caveat: Llama-3.3-70B's Phase-1 frozen anchor (teacher_acc 51.64, geom_auc 0.6628, n=2223) was generated via vLLM+AWQ on a 2223-sample subset, whereas ALL other teachers (Qwen/GLM/Phi/Yi/Gemma) use the HF-bf16 full 4608-sample pipeline. Re-scoring Llama70B on the SAME full-4608 HF pipeline gives teacher_acc 72.79, geom_auc 0.8183, correct_wrong_sep 1.0648 (n=4608). We keep the 2223 value as the pre-registered anchor (predicted_rank below) and ALSO report the 4608-consistent variant as a sensitivity check in the final H1 correlation. Both are recorded; neither is chosen post-hoc to fit distillation results.

protocol: For each new teacher: (1) generate real logprobs, (2) compute prior features via frozen predictor, (3) APPEND its features + predicted_rank here and git-commit (its individual freeze line), (4) ONLY THEN run student distillation (3 seeds, Stage-1, vs baseline + random control). Distillation gains are recorded separately in phase2 results, never back-edited into this file's predictions.
